name: Hub — phased mission (world → demo)
description: Weekday agent pass: auto-route Phase 1 ladder fix or Phase 2 gameplay milestone. Does not run FullWorld rebuild.

prompts.prompt:
You are finishing the Hub Unity project at /Users/jacob/Hub.

READ FIRST:
1. AGENTS.md
2. docs/CURSOR_BOT_PHASED_MISSION.md
3. docs/CURSOR_BOT_BACKLOG.md

PHASE ROUTING:
- Read Assets/EnvironmentKit/Generated/CaveBuildQualityReport.json
- If buildAcceptable is false OR overallScore < 85 → PHASE 1 (world):
  - Read CaveBuildGeneratedJsonManifest.json and active ladder rung
  - Use skill hub-game-completion
  - Fix ONE rung only under Packages/.../Editor/
- Else read Assets/Scripts/HubGameProgress.json
- If demoReady is false → PHASE 2 (gameplay):
  - Use skill hub-gameplay-completion
  - Complete ONE pending milestone G1–G8 in Assets/Scripts/
  - Update HubGameProgress.json status
- Else → PHASE 3 polish (Stream E, human-directed scope only)

RULES:
- Do NOT start Full AAA Rebuild unless human explicitly asked.
- JSON on disk is truth.

WHEN DONE:
- Summarize phase, milestone/rung, and files changed.
- Tell human to re-grade (Phase 1) or Play Mode smoke test (Phase 2).
